question: Should OpenClaw add agent-scoped web/tool credential settings, and should they live under `agents.list[].tools.web.search` or a broader per-agent plugin/SecretRef config contract shared with #55401?
rationale: This changes public config, credential isolation, plugin config precedence, and provider routing behavior; source inspection proves the gap but not the intended permanent contract.

options.title: Design shared agent-scoped credential contract
options.body: Define a narrow generic contract that covers built-in web search and plugin-owned webSearch config so API keys, providers, and SecretRefs have one precedence model.

options.title: Add web-search-only overrides
options.body: Allow `agents.list[].tools.web.search` for the reported use case, accepting that plugin-specific config may need a separate later design.

options.title: Keep global/plugin config only
options.body: Decline the core config expansion and document multiple gateways or external env isolation as the supported separation path.

recommendation.title: Design shared agent-scoped credential contract
recommendation.body: Define a narrow generic contract that covers built-in web search and plugin-owned webSearch config so API keys, providers, and SecretRefs have one precedence model.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses per-agent config defaults and resolver behavior, where Vincent Koc has the strongest recent feature-history signal.
